Who We Are
 We don’t just develop embedded software — we engineer intelligence into products. The Embedded Competence Center at NTT DATA Romania brings together experts in embedded systems, firmware development, and hardware–software integration, delivering robust and high-performance solutions for complex, safety-critical environments. With strong expertise in C/C++, AUTOSAR, real-time operating systems, and communication protocols, we design scalable embedded architectures, integrate software seamlessly with hardware, and ensure compliance with industry standards. Across the industries we support — from Automotive and Industrial Automation to Smart Devices and IoT — we transform reliable embedded technology into a foundation for innovative, dependable products.
We're looking for an experienced Hardware Design Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end hardware development of High Voltage Battery Management Systems (HV BMS), including schematic design, circuit simulation, validation, testing, technical documentation, and close collaboration with customers and cross-functional teams. We welcome applications from both permanent employees and freelance professionals with relevant expertise in automotive hardware development.
 What You'll Be Doing
Performing development tasks based on existing hardware specifications and architectures
Creating/updating and validating(worst case calculation & simulation) circuit diagrams
Writing test specifications and performing hardware electrical test on development samples
Performing process documentation(planning, module docu., layout requirements, FMEA)
Support technical knowledge sharing and provide guidance to less experienced engineers when required.
 What You'll Bring Along
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Embedded Systems, or a related engineering field.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in HW development
Strong knowledge of analog and digital hardware design for automotive applications.
Experience with High Voltage Battery Management Systems (HV BMS) and Li-Ion battery technologies.
Good understanding of Functional Safety (ISO 26262) requirements and their implementation in hardware development.
Knowledge of EMC/EMI design principles and hardware robustness requirements.
Experience in hardware reliability analysis and FMEA.
Familiarity with electrical simulation tools such as LTspice, PSpice, or equivalent.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with customers and cross-functional teams in an international environmen
